## Type of Changes
* [ ] Bug fix
* [ ] New feature
* [ ] Changes affecting sandbox/permission model (host_exec, trust tier, integrity check)

## Checklist
* [ ] I have executed `python tests/run.py --ci` locally and verified all tests pass.
* [ ] If changes affect sandbox/permissions: I have evaluated the security impacts on B1-B3, TRUSTED_PLUGIN_HASHES, or registry pin-hashes.
* [ ] If dependencies were added/modified: I have executed `cargo audit` locally.
* [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated.
